# Symbols

The symbol types of the model, one section per type.

## SYMPointSymbol

A symbol for point geometries.

| Property | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `size` | number |
| `layers` | SYMSymbolLayer[] |

## SYMLineSymbol

A symbol for line geometries.

## How to read these tables

Optional properties are marked with a question mark.
